gaps: Quantization seed is exactly int3(AtlasCoord, View.StateFrameIndexMod8 + 2); StateFrameIndexMod8 = FrameIndex % 8 (SceneRendering.cpp:1935). Without the frame uniform the dither cannot be reproduced.
IndirectLightingAtlas downsample clamp is compiled out when RADIOSITY_ATLAS_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR==1 (LumenRadiosity.ush:13); the clamp formula is recorded for the 2x permutation.
Final write to PF_FloatR11G11B10/PF_FloatRGBA/PF_A32B32G32R32F is rounded by the RHI/format conversion; the schema models the shader-side dither but not the hardware conversion rule.

Field bit offsets are exact only for PF_FloatR11G11B10 (fields[].appliesToFormats). storage.formatVariants records the explicit PF_FloatRGBA (4x16-bit) and PF_A32B32G32R32F (4x32-bit) channel layouts; format-specific hardware rounding/quantization and alpha use are not claimed complete.
